channels.specific: Roth ICM1958 p206 gives weighted derivative-minimum index. Local manuscript Lemma4-1 proves binary product additivity and its determinant proof uses iterated finite products.
channels.general: General search found real-weight initial forms and Sturmfels Groebner Bases and Convex Polytopes. Maximum/minimum conventions exchange by reversing weights; initial forms can have tied terms.

Tropical initial degeneration for systems of algebraic differential equations (Sep19 2023), arXiv2309.10761, within five years; opened abstract supports valuation and initial-form context, not exact normalized index law.

standard_form: Minimum additive monomial weight on finite polynomial support, with infinity at zero, is additive on finite products over a domain. Prove using products of lowest homogeneous pieces. Natural-weight power series provide a uniform existing variant.
scope: Only exact hr-free reciprocal law and natural-weight generic law are compiled. Arbitrary real infDegree law remains a design proposal. Different zero conventions and maximum/minimum orientations must be distinguished.
